services.name: VIP Tandem
services.desc: Flexible and Convenient This “Flexible and Convenient” option is designed for customers who need peace of mind and control over their booking, especially those with tight schedules or who are traveling. Here’s a summary of the key features: Refundable: You can get a full refund, minus a $35 office fee, if you cancel

gap: Exact duration of the jump experience not stated
blurb: Guests experience tandem skydiving with a certified instructor, including a training session, gear, a plane ride, freefall, and parachute ride. Jump altitudes range from 10,000 to 14,000 feet with freefall times of 30-60 seconds depending on package and conditions. The facility offers photo and video packages to capture the jump.
extraNote: Full refund minus $50 cancellation fee if VIP jump cancelled at least 14 days before purchase; no refunds after 180 days · Deposits are non-refundable · Reschedule or transfer allowed for weather or with 48 hours notice · No refunds if denied service for safety reasons after prepayment · Late arrival or no-show fees apply · Video/photo packages refundable only before gearing up or 30 minutes before flight

quotes.author: Christian Rimbau
quotes.text: I can’t stress enough that everyone should go skydiving, and what better place to go than Skydive Houston. Not only do they give you the unforgettable experience of your lifetime, but they also ensure your safety and treat you with great hospitality. They’re welcoming and I absolutely loved my time. I’ll never forget this and I definitely plan on getting my skydiving license. Skydiving instructor Tony was a unit and a cool professional. Highly recommend everyone to go Skydive Houston!

quotes.author: Josh Briggs
quotes.text: This place was great, they are super professional. It’s was an amazing experience!! I want to add to this, if your scared about doing it don’t be scared of the gear or what if the chute doesn’t open etc, these guys do this day after day and they trust their stuff. Have confidence that they jump for a living; they trust their gear and your both sharing the same parachute. I will definitely be coming back!

quotes.author: Angel Reyes
quotes.text: Amazing experience! Staff was very helpful even before date of jump! Easy to find, and convenient parking. Every staff member was extremely knowledgeable, and quick to help. Felt completely safe and secure through the whole process. Came here to celebrate a birthday, will definitely come here again and recommend getting the picture and video package. We loved it!

quotes.author: Norycee Johnson
quotes.text: This experience was way better than I expected. From the front desk admin to the instructors everything was perfect they made you feel comfortable at home like family and I feel like a pro if I could get this review 10 stars I would if you haven’t done skydiving or be scared this is your first time this is the place to go!

quotes.author: Noemie Vivier
quotes.text: Everybody was so nice!!! It was amazing .. I don’t even have the words. Best DAY of my LIFE. I jumped with Austin he was really sweet. If you’re thinking about getting the pictures and the video it is quite pricey but I’m telling you, the jump is crazy so you’d be happy to keep the memories. ?

quotes.author: Mikki Mohr
quotes.text: These guys rock!! Went for my 1st time Wednesday. They made it feel so easy I definitely want to jump enough times to be able to jump alone!! Ask to jump with Austin he's incredibly hot so if something were to go wrong atleast you have some eye candy before ? I will definitely be back soon!
